params.name: printInfo
params.description: Object containing printing attributes; see 4D View Pro print attributes

params.name: sheet
params.description: Sheet index to print (current sheet if omitted)

sentinelValues.meaning: Explicitly designates the current spreadsheet (same as omitting sheet).

overloads.semanticRole: The VP SET PRINT INFO command defines the attributes to use when printing the vpAreaName .

constraints: If vpAreaName does not exist, an error is returned.
